body: Add a download/restore path for the non-default tracked model weights (models/sibling-context, models/tiered-v1, models/char-cnn-v7) — extend .github/scripts/download-model.sh or add a fetch step — THEN git rm --cached them. Blocks the rest of ac-06. sibling-context is the load-bearing one (default pipeline); tiered/char-cnn are legacy --model-type opt-ins.
